jobs.job_description:
AI Presales Engineer - Generative AI & Enterprise Solutions

Location: Riyadh or Jeddah, Saudi Arabia - must be based in country already!

We are partnering with a leading global technology and digital services organisation to appoint an AI Presales Engineer in Saudi Arabia.

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of enterprise technology, artificial intelligence and commercial solution design, helping major organisations translate complex business challenges into practical, scalable AI solutions.

You will play a key role throughout the technical sales cycle, working closely with commercial teams and enterprise customers to shape AI strategies, design tailored architectures and demonstrate the business value of emerging technologies, including Generative AI, large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agentic AI workflows.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead technical discovery sessions with C-suite executives, business stakeholders and technical teams to identify challenges and qualify AI opportunities.

• Design secure, scalable enterprise AI architectures using LLMs, vector databases, conversational interfaces and cloud or hybrid environments.

• Develop proof-of-concepts, prototypes and tailored demonstrations to validate technical feasibility and demonstrate business value.

• Partner with sales teams to shape customer solutions and support the progression of complex enterprise opportunities.

• Lead technical responses to RFPs and RFIs, including statements of work, bills of materials and project delivery estimates.

• Advise customers on AI implementation considerations, including data privacy, security, data sovereignty and regulatory compliance.

• Translate complex technical concepts into compelling business propositions for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What We're Looking For

• 5-7+ years of experience in technical presales, solutions engineering or a similar customer-facing technical role.

• A demonstrable track record of working with machine learning, NLP or Generative AI deployments.

• Strong understanding of LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases and agentic AI applications.

• Practical experience with Python and frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.

• Exposure to enterprise AI platforms and cloud environments, including Azure AI, AWS Bedrock or Google Cloud.

• Experience designing solutions for enterprise customers, developing PoCs and supporting complex technical sales cycles.

• Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage senior decision-makers.

• A bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Engineering or a related technical discipline.

• Experience delivering AI solutions within large, complex enterprise environments.

• Familiarity with hybrid cloud, private cloud and enterprise data environments.

• Experience navigating data security, sovereignty and compliance considerations in the GCC.

• Arabic language skills and familiarity with the Saudi Arabian enterprise market.

Compensation & Location

The position is based in Riyadh or Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

Saudi nationals and Arabic-speaking professionals are particularly encouraged to apply, although candidates of all nationalities will be considered.

imkan.ai is an international Data and AI consultancy headquartered in Saudi Arabia, specialising in engineering-led solutions across data infrastructure and agentic AI systems. We partner with global enterprises to move data and AI from concept to production, building things that actually run.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will lead the design, development, and deployment of production-grade agentic AI and LLM systems for enterprise clients across Saudi Arabia. This is not a research role. You will own multi-agent architectures, RAG pipelines, and LLM integrations end-to-end, from architecture through to live deployment. You will work embedded with client teams and in close coordination with imkan.ai’s engineering leads.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Build and maintain production-grade data pipelines to support LLM ingestion, embedding generation, and retrieval workflows

• Design vector store architectures and manage embedding pipelines across structured and unstructured enterprise data sources

• Manage cloud AI infrastructure on Azure or AWS, including model hosting, API gateway management, and cost optimisation

• Enforce data quality, lineage, and governance standards relevant to enterprise AI deployments in regulated environments

• Define observability standards for AI systems including logging, tracing, drift detection, and cost monitoring in production

Agentic AI & Generative AI

• Build and maintain end-to-end AI orchestration pipelines covering data ingestion, model inference, and result delivery

• Design and operate RAG pipelines with vector databases for enterprise knowledge retrieval

• Engineer, version, and continuously refine prompts for production LLM applications

• Integrate LLMs with external tools and APIs to build autonomous, multi-step agentic workflows

• Implement model evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and safety checks for enterprise LLM deployments across client environments

• Lead incident triage and root-cause analysis for AI-driven services in production

• Collaborate with data scientists, product owners, and platform engineers across time zones

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Programming & Frameworks

• AI/ML: PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LangGraph

• Agentic frameworks: LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar multi-agent orchestration tools

• Data tooling: dbt, PySpark, Airflow, Kafka or Flink

• Cloud: Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP

Domain Experience

• 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering production AI or data systems, not PoC or academic projects

• Hands-on with LLMs: prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG, model compression

• At least one agentic AI system taken from design through to production

• Familiarity with AI model risk frameworks and audit trail requirements

• Experience delivering AI solutions in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC region is a strong advantage

Ways of Working

• Fluent English, written and spoken. This is the working language across all teams

• Currently based in Saudi Arabia with a valid, transferable Iqama. This is a non-negotiable requirement

• Agile/Scrum proficiency; able to self-manage against sprint commitments

NICE TO HAVE

• Familiarity with Saudi data and AI governance frameworks, NCA requirements, or PDPL compliance considerations

• MLflow or equivalent for experiment tracking and model registry

Work Model: Hybrid (Blend of office, client site, and home)

The Opportunity

Join a global leader in Insights & Data as we redefine the boundaries of AI, platform engineering, and advanced analytics. Our team is at the forefront of end-to-end data integration and AI engineering, delivering sector-specific solutions that transform the world's leading businesses.

We are seeking a visionary GenAI Specialist to design, build, and deploy next-generation AI solutions. This role is perfect for a technical expert who balances deep analytical skills with strategic foresight, helping us optimize production-ready pipelines and foster an environment of relentless innovation.

Your Role

As a GenAI Specialist, you will be instrumental in integrating LLMs and implementing data strategies that drive business growth. Your focus will include:

• Advanced AI Engineering: Building MCP models, context protocols, and agentic AI while maintaining robust microservices.

• Financial Intelligence: Deploying ML models to detect and prevent financial crimes, significantly reducing fraud losses and improving compliance.

• Generative Innovation: Implementing GenAI solutions to create synthetic data, enhancing model accuracy across diverse use cases.

• Scale & Efficiency: Rolling out scalable ML systems capable of processing millions of daily transactions and utilizing A/B testing to boost operational efficiency.

• Production Standards: Writing production-grade, PEP8-compliant Python code with a strict focus on scalability and maintainability.

• Strategic Collaboration: Translating complex data concepts into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders and leadership.

Your Skills and Experience

To excel in this role, you should bring a proven track record in GenAI technologies and a hands-on approach to problem-solving.

Technical Requirements:

• LLM Mastery: Expertise in RAG, Agents, Graph RAG, RAFT, and Fine-tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA).

• Model Proficiency: Experience with both Open Source (Llama, Mistral) and Closed Source (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini) models.

• Core Engineering: Advanced Python skills, specifically within NLP and GenAI frameworks.

• Deep Learning: Strong experience with GANs, VAEs, and Transformers.

• NLP Expertise: Proficiency in intent recognition, entity extraction, text summarization, and topic modeling.

Bonus Points For:

• Foundational knowledge of Cloud environments, API frameworks, and Docker.

• Experience with databases such as Qdrant or PostgreSQL.

Why Join Us?

When you join our collective of free-thinkers and industry experts, you aren't just taking a job—you're helping reimagine what's possible. We offer a platform where you can:

• Shape the Future: Transform leading businesses through sustainable and inclusive technology.

• Collaborate Globally: Work alongside 340,000+ team members in over 50 countries.

• Continuous Growth: Benefit from a culture of knowledge sharing and high-level skill development.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on AI Lead to join one of our clients, a growing technology company, and lead its AI strategy and delivery. You'll manage and mentor a small team of engineers and data scientists, working closely with business and technology stakeholders to turn business needs into practical AI solutions with measurable results.

Alongside leading the team, you'll contribute to solution architecture, development and technical reviews, ensuring AI applications are reliable, secure and cost-effective.

What you'll do

• Define the AI strategy, roadmap and priorities with business and technology leadership, aligning initiatives with business objectives.
• Lead and mentor ML engineers and data scientists, setting clear goals, reviewing technical work and supporting team development.
• Assess business problems and prioritise AI use cases based on value, feasibility, data readiness and implementation effort.
• Own end-to-end AI delivery, from discovery and experimentation through development, deployment and ongoing monitoring.
• Contribute directly to solution architecture, development and code reviews, establishing clear engineering and documentation standards.
• Build applications using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and generative AI, selecting traditional machine learning or simpler approaches where appropriate.
• Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure reliable data pipelines and suitable data quality for training, evaluation and production use.
• Establish MLOps practices for experiment tracking, versioning, testing, deployment, monitoring and retraining where needed.
• Define evaluation criteria and track model quality, business impact, latency and operating costs.
• Evaluate generative AI applications for accuracy, hallucinations, safety and reliability before release and throughout production use.
• Partner with legal, security and compliance teams to address applicable PDPL, data governance and data residency requirements.
• Evaluate vendors, tools and platforms, making clear build-versus-buy recommendations.
• Communicate progress, results, risks and investment needs to senior stakeholders in clear business terms.

What you bring

• 7+ years of experience in data science, machine learning or AI engineering, including at least 3 years managing and mentoring technical teams.
• A proven track record of deploying and maintaining AI solutions in production, beyond proofs of concept.
• Strong Python programming skills and experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or scikit-learn.
• Hands-on experience building LLM applications, including RAG, prompt engineering and evaluation methods.
• Experience with vector search technologies such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus or pgvector.
• Experience designing AI architectures and integrating models into business applications through APIs and services.
• Experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure or GCP.
• Practical experience with MLOps tools or platforms such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Amazon SageMaker or Azure Machine Learning.
• Familiarity with Docker, Git and CI/CD pipelines for testing, packaging and deploying AI applications.
• Strong understanding of data quality, model evaluation and the trade-offs between performance, reliability, cost and speed.
• Ability to translate business needs into technical priorities and make informed delivery decisions.
• Awareness of privacy, security and responsible AI considerations across the development lifecycle.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English. Arabic is an advantage.

Nice to have

• Familiarity with LLM application frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, and tools for evaluating and monitoring LLM applications.
• Experience with Hugging Face Transformers and adapting pretrained models to specific use cases.
• Experience deploying and managing AI workloads on Kubernetes.
• Experience with Arabic NLP or Arabic-language LLM applications.
• Experience delivering AI solutions in banking, fintech, government or telecom in the GCC.
• Familiarity with SDAIA guidance and responsible AI frameworks.
• A master's degree in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science or a related field.
